key_points: Halliburton secured a multi‑year well construction and completions contract with Eni for the Cronos ultra‑deepwater gas project in Cyprus
The deal expands HAL’s offshore footprint and adds incremental revenue in a high‑margin segment
Analysts note the contract could narrow the valuation gap, suggesting the stock may be 15‑20% undervalued
Recent share‑price dip (~3% decline) appears reactionary and may present a short‑term buying opportunity
Impact expected to materialize over the next several quarters as the project progresses
